entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return some cycling shoes. Order number is VF-886103. Just tell me if I can do it.
Okay, I can definitely look into that return for you. One moment while I pull up the order... VF-886103. I see it here. To understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They don't fit right. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but they just gave me terrible blisters on my heel. I can't use them. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that the shoes caused blisters. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see they were delivered 46 days ago.
Right. So can I return them or not? Yes or no.
Yes, you can. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that window.
Great. Finally. What do I do next?

I have just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, we will process your full refund.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
